discrepancies.topic: F-WRD-001 open question - does the Elixir /calibration/worlds endpoint exist?
discrepancies.recorded_claim: capabilities_D_worldmodel.md:119 - 'Whether the runtime Elixir /calibration/worlds endpoint exists was not confirmed in R0 (unknown)'
discrepancies.actual: It does NOT exist. git grep 'calibration/worlds' over *.ex/*.exs returns zero hits. The runtime router exposes /api/v1/observatory/worlds (tiannara_runtime_web/router.ex:28-29); the root router's /api scope has no calibration entry (lib/tiannara/web/router.ex:49-84).
discrepancies.resolution: Closed as CONFIRMED ABSENT. The API's mock fallback is the only reachable path (F-ARC-227).

discrepancies.recorded_claim: F-PLT-006 / F-ARC-020 - 'NATS integration includes an emulated TCP transport with ambiguous fallback semantics'; runtime has both gnat (mix.exs:32-49) and a hand-rolled raw TCP listener (nats/connection.ex:15-24)
discrepancies.actual: Not ambiguous - the gnat client is hard-disabled. TiannaraRuntime.EventGateway.connect_nats/0 returns {:error, :unavailable} unconditionally (event_gateway.ex:182-185) and the module is in no boot tree. The boot-wired path is 100% the emulated transport.

discrepancies.recorded_claim: tiannara_runtime/config/config.exs:15-18 configures TiannaraRuntime.NATS.ConnectionManager (server_url, reconnect delays) and docs/config/dev.exs + test.exs configure it again
discrepancies.actual: No module named TiannaraRuntime.NATS.ConnectionManager exists anywhere in tiannara_runtime/lib (git grep 'defmodule TiannaraRuntime.NATS.ConnectionManager' = 0 hits). The directory contains 19 files, none of them connection_manager.ex.
discrepancies.resolution: Dead configuration key - same defect class as the removed start_app key (TIANNARA_RUNTIME_TEST_INVENTORY.md:168).

discrepancies.recorded_claim: The CPL provides 'six independent checkpoint layers' for runtime state, knowledge graph, ontology, experiments, evolution, certification (constitutional_persistence_layer.ex:12-18)
discrepancies.actual: checkpoint_all_layers/1 calls create_checkpoint_record(layer, %{}, acc) for every layer (:376) - the state_hash is the hash of an EMPTY MAP. No subsystem state is ever captured in a checkpoint.
discrepancies.resolution: The six-layer description is aspirational. recover/0 also hard-codes runtime_restored: true (:289) without restoring anything.

discrepancies.topic: Docstring vs behaviour - NATS connection status
discrepancies.recorded_claim: Tiannara.NATS.MetaEvolutionStreamManager exposes get_status/0 for operational monitoring
discrepancies.actual: get_status/0 returns connected: true unconditionally (state initialised with connected: true at :17) and a hard-coded url 'nats://127.0.0.1:4222' (:83), while the module publishes only into the in-VM Bus (:70-73).
discrepancies.resolution: Health dashboards would report a healthy NATS link that does not exist (F-ARC-228).

discrepancies.actual: --safe only selects the profile 'safe-mode' whose phases are [:env, :runtime, :health] (tiannara.start.ex:11, :68-75). There is no runtime safety semantics, no kill switch, no degraded-mode persistence.
discrepancies.resolution: 'Safe Mode' is a launcher profile name, not a safety mechanism (F-GOV-013 already records the kill switch as non-functional).

discrepancies.topic: Port collision in the documented restart path
discrepancies.recorded_claim: restart_backend.bat - 'Starting Tiannara API backend on port 8004'
discrepancies.actual: 8004 is the tiannara_runtime Phoenix dev endpoint port (tiannara_runtime/config/dev.exs:4). The Python API and the Elixir runtime cannot both bind it.
discrepancies.resolution: Documented start scripts are mutually inconsistent with the runtime configuration.

discrepancies.recorded_claim: The umbrella app observatory_api has a Phoenix router
discrepancies.actual: TWO routers coexist in the same app: lib/observatory_api/router.ex (controllers + 8 channels) and lib/observatory_api_web/router.ex (status controller + observatory channel/socket); endpoint.ex plugs ObservatoryApi.Router while observatory_api_web/endpoint.ex exists separately.
discrepancies.resolution: Duplicated web surface inside one umbrella app; not covered by F-ARC-021 (namespace hygiene) - recorded here.

discrepancies.actual: The wiring audit does not contain that enumeration. GENSERVER_RECONCILIATION.md:43-81 lists 35 confirmed zero-evidence GenServers; problems_G.md F-ARC-010 already records this discrepancy.
